name: Litany of Hate
text: While this model leads a unit, every melee attack made by a model in that unit, the leader included, adds 1 to its wound roll.

name: Refuse to Yield
text: Each time an attack is allocated to this model, halve the Damage of that attack, rounding up. Ranged and melee attacks alike.

name: Bladeguard
text: At the start of each Fight phase, in either player's turn, you may pick one stance for this unit that lasts until the phase ends: Swords of the Chapter or Shields of the Chapter.

name: Swords of the Chapter
text: While this stance is chosen, melee attacks made by models in this unit may re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

name: Shields of the Chapter
text: While this stance is chosen, each invulnerable saving throw made for a model in this unit may be re-rolled if the roll is a 1. Armour saves are never re-rolled by this.
